name: Robinhood Agent Trading MCP
description: Connects an external AI agent to Robinhood to read portfolio, balance and order data and place trades only in a dedicated Robinhood Agentic account.

skills.name: Account and Portfolio
skills.description: Answers questions about your portfolio value, buying power, positions, balances and account information across your Robinhood accounts.

skills.name: Transactions and Orders
skills.description: Reads details of your transactions, including your order history, across all your Robinhood accounts.

skills.name: Place Orders
skills.description: Places equities, options and crypto orders with the available order types, only in your dedicated Robinhood Agentic account.

skills.name: Market Data and Watchlists
skills.description: Gets market data such as recent quotes for tickers and works with your Robinhood watchlists through the watchlist tools.
